description: Xena Studios' shared Renovate settings. A release has to be 3 days old before Renovate proposes it (security fixes excepted): pnpm refuses packages newer than a day, and a bad release is usually pulled within days. A repo uses them with "extends": ["local>xena-studios/.github:renovate-config"] and adds its own rules, such as automerge where CI covers everything a merge changes.

packageRules.description: Third-party actions run with the repo's secrets, so they're pinned to a commit (CodeQL flags tags, which can be moved); Renovate keeps the pins current. GitHub's own actions stay on tags. Every repo gets this; a repo's own copy of the rule is harmless.
Node's major versions move across the org together, on purpose: a new major waits on the Dependency Dashboard until it's approved there, so no repo drifts onto one alone.
